package.name: manual_return_sim
package.description: Pre-flight virtual test rig for the manual+return mission. Simulates the RMD-X8 CAN motors + IMU on a vcan0 bus so the real rmd_x8_driver_node/reduced_odom_node/drive_cmd_mux/return_navigation stack can be exercised end-to-end (record a path, trigger RETURN, watch the 180-degree turn + path-following return) without real hardware. Not launched in production (manual_return_bringup.launch.py does not depend on this package).
